classification_notes.description: No Admin Web caller exists for POST /admin/v1/router/preview, POST /admin/v1/principals/{principal_id}/plugin-chain/rebalance, or PUT /admin/v1/plugin-chain-entries/{id}; each is cataloged with its source behavior and parameters.

POST /admin/v1/router/preview is intentionally a read-only POST because its simulation input is a JSON body. It performs no storage query, audit append, external request, cache mutation, or persistent side effect.

POST /admin/v1/config/save writes the validated draft to the config file on disk via atomic replace and clears the draft; it does not mutate runtime state (restart_required: true). The previous apply/reload/current/diff/schema routes and the CurrentConfig in-memory apply path are removed by the master Settings rework; ConfigStore::append_config_history is now invoked by save (metadata-only rows) and ConfigStore::get_config_history is removed.
PATCH /admin/v1/plugins/registry/{id} updates the registry label and dynamic view but does not call record_admin_audit; no audit operation is attributed.

POST /admin/v1/plugins/wasm/gc deletes only orphan blobs (sha256 absent from wasm_registry_v2) and their local cache files — registry-referenced blobs are kept even at refcount 0 — and does not emit an admin audit event.

Removed by merge with master b07b25ee: GET /admin[/v1]/config/current, GET /admin[/v1]/config/schema, GET /admin[/v1]/config/diff, GET /admin/config/draft, POST /admin[/v1]/config/apply, POST /admin[/v1]/config/reload, POST /admin/config/draft/validate, PUT /admin/config/draft. Replacements: GET /admin/v1/config/editor (supersedes current+schema), POST /admin/v1/config/save (supersedes apply), POST /admin/v1/config/draft/download (supersedes diff/export of draft), remaining config routes are v1-only.

gaps.title: Command Palette Pages group missing Audit route
gaps.description: CommandPalette.tsx lists Overview, Upstreams, Principals, Plugins, Logs, and Settings in the Pages group, but omits the /audit route, even though it exists in Sidebar.tsx.

gaps.title: Event detail query missing from UI-OV-12 inventory item
gaps.description: UI-OV-12 was documented purely as a UI row click action, but selecting any finalized request row triggers an asynchronous network fetch to GET /admin/v1/events/detail/{eventId} via useRequestEventDetail.

SSE reconnect delta query (/admin/v1/events/delta) is only called when lastCursor is known and resumeNeedsBackfill is true. If connection drops on initial load before any event arrives, it reconnects directly without backfill.
gaps.mitigation: Verified: tested in useLiveEventStream tests; initial cursor null connects directly to /admin/v1/events/stream.

gaps.description: Model filter is debounced by 300ms in client. Fast typing will not issue network requests per keystroke, but typing rapidly across the 300ms boundary produces sequential queries.

gaps.area: Cache Keepalive Sessions List Query Limit
gaps.observation: useCacheKeepaliveSummary explicitly queries with limit=0 to return metrics without rows. However, useCacheKeepaliveSessions does not specify a limit parameter, causing the request to omit limit and rely on backend default pagination size (e.g. 50 or 100).

HorizonToggle with 'all' sends horizon=all in the query string. In contrast, status filter 'all' omits the status parameter entirely (undefined). The 'error' filter chip also omits status but sets error=true in the query string.

Changing the horizon value creates a distinct TanStack Query key (['cache-keepalive', 'sessions', principalId, { horizon, ... }]). This resets the infinite query cursor back to page 1 (pageParam: undefined). Cursor metadata is not shared across horizons.
The LLM Judge control in CacheKeepaliveSettingsDrawer is visually rendered with opacity-50 and a badge 'Reserved for a future release', with no interactive handler or backend wire mapping.
ApiKeysCard explicitly prevents Escape, backdrop click, or close button dismissal while a newly generated plaintext key is displayed, requiring the operator to click 'Done' after copying.

gaps.description: WASM binary download feature is completely missing from both backend and frontend. The prompt asks for 'download' tracking, but neither GET /admin/v1/plugins/wasm/{id} nor any export button in PluginDetailIntegrity / PluginCatalog exists.
gaps.workaround: Operators must retain original .wasm files offline; wasm bytecode cannot be downloaded back from the dashboard.

gaps.description: Four REST endpoints implemented in crates/cc-lb-admin/src/v1/plugins.rs are never called by the admin web UI: (1) GET /admin/v1/plugins/registry/{id} (UI fetches whole registry and finds by ID in memory), (2) POST /admin/v1/principals/{principal_id}/plugin-chain/rebalance (re-spacing order integers), (3) GET /admin/v1/plugin-chain-entries/{id} (single chain entry fetch), and (4) PUT /admin/v1/plugin-chain-entries/{id} (single chain entry update).
gaps.workaround: Document as backend-only endpoints; UI uses list and insert/delete primitives.

gaps.description: PluginDetailOperate displays static text indicating 'Health metrics for individual plugins are not yet available in the dashboard' and points to raw Prometheus metric names (cc_lb_plugin_call_duration_seconds, cc_lb_plugin_trap_total). There is no live telemetry or chart in the UI.
gaps.workaround: Operators must use external Prometheus / Grafana dashboards for plugin latency and trap metrics.

gaps.title: No Config Draft Discard API or UI Action
gaps.description: Neither the backend axum routes (routes.rs) nor the frontend (ConfigEditor.tsx) implements a draft discard/delete endpoint or button; a saved draft can only be overwritten by a new PUT or by saving to the config file.
gaps.resolution: Documented in state transition rules; no discard button exists in merged source.

gaps.title: Audit Query Hardcoded Limit and Missing Pagination Controls
gaps.description: AuditPage requests useAudit with limit='200'. The UI table displays at most 200 admin rows and a static 'No more entries' footer. There are no next/previous page buttons, cursor tokens, or infinite scrolling.
gaps.resolution: Documented as fixed-cap single-page query. Users must use time range bounds (since/until) and principal filters to inspect older or segmented events.

gaps.title: Audit Client-Side Admin Action Filtering
gaps.description: GET /admin/v1/audit returns all audit_log_v1 rows matching query bounds, but the UI client explicitly filters for entries where admin_action != null || kind != null. Regular proxy request logs returned by the endpoint are silently omitted from the table view.
gaps.resolution: Documented in audit renderRows filtering logic.

gaps.description: WarmupConfigModal is conditionally rendered when pluginSnapshot exists with open={configOpen}, but configOpen is initialized to false and no button or interaction anywhere in WarmupCardMinimal or the UI ever calls setConfigOpen(true). It is an unreachable dead modal in production.
Triggering Fire Now sends an actual /messages payload directly upstream to Anthropic, burning real account tokens and potentially incurring billable usage or rate limit depletion.
Static source reconciliation does not prove browser behavior, production entity coverage, latency, or deployed availability.
No Admin Web action or backend route discards a config draft.
The UI downloads a database export from GET /admin/v1/export; it has no standalone config download action.
Neither frontend nor backend exposes uploaded WASM bytecode download.

The env:{api_key_env} display branch is source-only/unreachable because UpstreamResponse omits api_key_env. That write-only credential contract is unchanged. The separately approved Base URL clear contract is now implemented via explicit clear_base_url: true (omitted or null base_url preserves the override); the form captures the edit-time baseline so a mid-edit refetch cannot fabricate a clear, and an unconfirmed clear keeps the editor open with an error toast. Historical null-as-clear evidence remains a baseline limitation.
